subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR path for the Debug Snapshots fix, or close/supersede it and allow a fresh narrow fix from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open conflicting fork PR already uses closing syntax for this issue, so automated repair should not create a duplicate until the existing PR path is resolved.

options.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Supersede the unmergeable fork PR, then let a new focused Control UI change implement the loading and disconnected states against current main.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase and repair the fork branch, including localization, current-layout preservation, tests, and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Supersede the unmergeable fork PR, then let a new focused Control UI change implement the loading and disconnected states against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal for the original Debug controller/view wiring and dashboard surface.
